items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay notes he felt lack of power/explosion, practiced majority Thursday, will test pregame Sunday.
items.why: Calf injury limited power; pregame workout decisive.
items.implication: If OUT, Rams TE target share spikes (historically 37% without him); Higbee leads hierarchy.
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee/Colby Parkinson routes/targets elevate; Atwell etc. fill.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Ravens vs Bengals.
items.implication: Crucial for DFS/slate; if OUT, Ravens offense downgraded heavily.

items.text: Breece Hall listed QUESTIONABLE (quad) vs Dolphins.
items.implication: If active, start; Berry leans yes vs MIA.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers at Falcons; Shanahan confirmed Evans (Achilles) OUT.
items.why: Evans Achilles, Deebo hamstring; coach confirm.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; Kittle funnel + CMC slot potential.
items.opportunity: George Kittle routes/targets spike; CMC more slot/WR snaps possible.

items.text: David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet among key OUTs.
items.implication: Handcuffs/backups elevate; e.g. Charbonnet out boosts Seahawks other RBs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN; was allowed facility access for non-football activities.
items.implication: Back but workload questions post-layoff; Berry hates vs DET.
items.opportunity: Full role expected but monitors Lloyd/Johnson backups poor.

items.text: Brian Robinson ruled OUT (hamstring); listed among key OUTs.
items.implication: Sweet setup for Bijan vs SF DvP (inflates opp RB by 4.4%).
items.opportunity: Bijan Robinson full workload + receiving vs soft SF RB defense.

items.text: Rashee Rice and Davante Adams among players ruled OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: KC/LAR WR depth tested; Adams long-term (6-10 wks hamstring).
items.opportunity: If Puka also out, Rams TE share high; Worthy etc for KC.

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Calf limits explosion; McVay pregame test.
items.implication: TE-heavy attack; Higbee lead if OUT.
items.opportunity: Higbee/Parkinson target/route share surge (prior 37% TE share w/o Puka).

items.text: Bijan Robinson sweet setup vs SF with Brian Robinson OUT; SF DvP inflates opp RB prod 4.4% (7th-most), recent RB catches high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: BRob OUT + SF soft vs RB receiving.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts vs ATL due to scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT); rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted on CMC slot with Kaelon Black present amid WR injuries. CMC smiled on slot question.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel to TE/RB.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC potential extra routes/slot.
items.opportunity: Kittle target monopoly; CMC snap/route expansion.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle sprain) ruled OUT by coach Mike LaFleur; misses another game.

Loves Colston Loveland (30% TS/19.2 PPR w/ Caleb return, 6+ rec both games); A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% TS buy despite drops); Saquon Barkley if active vs DAL right back in lineups; also Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving. Hates Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Josh Jacobs.
items.why: Usage (Loveland TS, AJB routes/TS); matchups (Warren etc workloads); Saquon return.
items.implication: Start Loves; fade Hates (Odunze shadowed, Jacobs layoff).
items.opportunity: Loveland TE1 upside w/ Caleb; AJB volume buy-low.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may reduce 2-/3-TE sets giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR per Johnson; high YPRR efficiency.
